test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the sentence that has NO spelling errors.

options.text: My new phone has a high-resolusion screen and powerful proccessor, which makes it perfect for streming videos and playing games.
My new phone has a high-resollution screen and a powerfull procesor, which makes it perfect for streaming videos and playing games.
My new phone has a high-resolution screen and a powerful processor, which makes it perfect for streaming videos and playing games.
My new phone has a high-resolution screan and powerfull procesor, which makes it perfect for streming videos and playing games.

solution:
The correct answer is: **'****My new phone has a high-resolution screen and a powerful processor, which makes it perfect for streaming videos and playing games.****'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"resolution"** means the degree of detail visible in a photographic or television image.

 
 
• **Example: **The camera has a high **resolution**, capturing even the smallest details.
 
 
 
• The word **"processor"** refers to the central part of a computer or other device that performs the basic operations of the system.
 
 
• **Example: **The new smartphone is equipped with a powerful **processor **for fast performance.
 
 
 
• The word **"streaming"** means transmitting or receiving data (especially video and audio material) over a computer network as a steady, continuous flow.
 
 
• **Example: **We spent the evening **streaming **our favourite TV shows online.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: "resolusion" (संकल्प)** is misspelled; the correct spelling is "resolution".

 
 
• **Example: **The image quality improved with a higher resolution screen.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: "resollution" (संकल्प)** and "procesor" (प्रोसेसर) are misspelled; the correct spellings are "resolution" and "processor".
 
 
• **Example: **The resolution of the image was not clear.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: "screan" (स्क्रीन) and "procesor" (प्रोसेसर)** are misspelled; the correct spellings are "screen" and "processor".
 
 
• **Example: **The screen quality of the new phone is impressive.
 
 

21b:Tb06,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**
